overview: A guided Umrah from Lagos with five nights in Makkah and four in Madinah. Hotels are within walking distance of both mosques, a scholar travels with the group, and ziyarat visits are included in both cities. We process your Umrah visa and handle every transfer.

itinerary.title: Fly to Jeddah, transfer to Makkah
itinerary.description: Group flight from Lagos, meet-and-greet in Jeddah and coach transfer to your Makkah hotel.

itinerary.title: Perform Umrah
itinerary.description: Guided Umrah rituals with the group scholar.

itinerary.title: Makkah ziyarat
itinerary.description: Visits to Jabal al-Nour, Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat.

itinerary.title: Days of worship in Makkah
itinerary.description: Free days for prayer and worship at the Haram, with daily group sessions.

itinerary.title: Travel to Madinah
itinerary.description: Transfer to Madinah by high-speed train.
itinerary.meta: Meals: breakfast, dinner · Stay: hotel near Masjid an-Nabawi

itinerary.title: Madinah ziyarat
itinerary.description: Quba Mosque, Mount Uhud and the Qiblatayn Mosque.

itinerary.title: Return to Lagos
itinerary.description: Transfer to Madinah airport for your flight home.

included: 5 nights in Makkah, 4 nights in Madinah

faqs.q: Can women travel without a mahram?
faqs.a: Current Saudi rules allow women over 18 to perform Umrah in an approved group. We confirm the latest rules with you on WhatsApp.
